title: Ask for 20 Words, Get a Lesson Built From Those Words | vitalii.no
description:
Ask for "20 most common adverbs" or upload a PDF, and get a Norwegian lesson built entirely around those words - not a story that buries them in a narrative.

The only format before was a connected "story": Claude wove the requested words into a shared narrative, which read naturally but buried each word inside a plot you had to sit through in full. Uploading a document was worse - it just voiced the whole file, or built one long retelling, with no way to focus lesson time on the specific words that actually mattered.

A new topics.style column ("words", now the default) routes requests through word_plan(), which asks Claude to interpret phrases like "20 most common adverbs" - or a pasted document - into a pool of up to 60 Norwegian words, each with its dictionary form, an English gloss, a Ukrainian translation, and the inflected forms used to verify the word later. write_words() then generates 6, 8, or 10 independent example sentences per word in parallel batches, checking every sentence against the word's forms and rewriting it once if the word doesn't actually appear. Each word becomes its own audio section: spoken twice, translated, then drilled with its sentences.

The result: type a request or drop in a document, and the lesson is built entirely around the words that matter - confirmed back to the learner before listening even starts, no story required.
